about: Known causes of flaky Xenoform output, stopped before a render. Each rule clamps or warns; expert=true turns clamps into warnings except hard bans.

morph_density.why: 22 forms in 20 s read as laggy; about 15 per 20 s is the sweet spot.

morph_run_clean.why: A stutter or wobble inside a morph run reads as lag (the 12.8 s stutter in forms22).

simple_objects.why: Simple objects morph boringly; use complex shapes (feather, flower, coral, skull, machine).

duplicate_features.negative: multiple storms, duplicate eyes, duplicate features, extra rings, cartoon, illustration
duplicate_features.why: Generated planets hallucinate duplicate features (the multi-storm Jupiter). Anchor on NASA images.

character_motion.negative: extra fingers, fused fingers, deformed hands, pose snapping, jerky limbs
character_motion.why: Free-generated character motion snaps between poses and breaks hands; drive it from stock dance clips.

footage_motion.why: Near-static NASA/archive clips look frozen; skip clips under this motion score.

native_vertical.why: Wide renders cropped to 9:16 lose the subject; render native 448x768 and upscale.

morph_background.why: Non-black morph stills leak colour fringes and break the black-pool chain.

text_encoder.why: LTX-2.x wants the Gemma encoder (2048 dims); T5 gives 4096 and fails or renders noise.

vram.why: 12 GB cards OOM above 448x768 per shot, over 5 s per render, or with parallel local jobs.

ui_effects.why: Heavy FX on app shots looks messy; wobble sparingly and subtly.

shimmer.why: The wavy shimmer look ruins visuals and is banned outright.

open_weights.why: Partner/API nodes (hosted LTX-2.5) are not open weights; off in contest mode unless expert.
